correctness.rationale: Verified the normalized Bergman kernel and z² norm 1/3, reconstructed the two-dimensional Gram-inverse projection formula exactly from a complex unit phase and proved it equals P_t(1)-t(1−t)²(1−c)Q_t(c)/D_t(c), including its removable confluent-jet limit. For 0<t<1, D_t>0; Q_t is strictly convex with vertex 1/(2t)−1. Its constrained minimum is the quartic at c=1 for t≤1/4 and t(4t³−4t²+3t−2) for t≥1/4. The quartic decreases strictly on [0,1/4] with one crossing t0; the cubic strictly increases with one crossing t1. The strictly negative second derivative of log[(1−c)(c−r_-)(r_+−c)/D_t] in the Q<0 interval forces a unique separated global maximum. The exact positive P′_t(−1) excludes the antipodal end. At t=t0 only c=1 ties itself; at t=t1 c=1 and vertex c=1/(2t1)−1 tie, all other c inferior. Distinct-node attainment is correctly distinguished from the confluent 2D jet limit. An independently written SymPy/complex-Gram calculation verified polynomial identities and derivative and performed 500 random complex Gram comparisons, plus boundary representatives; finite checks only corroborate the continuum argument.

value.rationale: The precise placement of two samples constrained to a common circular radius is a natural inverse/approximation-design question in the canonical Bergman Hilbert space; the squared best projection energy for the quadratic monomial is an intrinsic, normalized invariant. Its exact all-radius angular maximum has a nontrivial continuous jet-splitting threshold t0, coexistence/discontinuous reentrant return threshold t1, a provably unique separated phase and a sharp attained/unattained boundary. These are not arbitrary tiny-radius numerics or routine rewriting of the general existence theorem; the result fully classifies a mathematically motivated constraint problem even though it makes no claim about unequal radii or higher numbers of kernels.
residual_risks: The conclusion is deliberately restricted to two sites sharing a fixed radius and target z²; no broader nonlinear-approximation theorem is claimed.
Its value is the exact constrained classification, not novelty of the general 2x2 Gram projection formula.
